triage.note: ENUMERATED DEBT, NOT A BUG BEING FIXED. American Express FY2008 addresses Part III under ONE combined heading covering four item codes at once -- raw bytes offset 1225493 of evals/fixtures/axp-2008/filing.htm: 'ITEMS 10, 11, 12 and 13.' plus the four-item title, then a ~2,987-char body. All four items report `missing` at confidence 0.40 with warning `expected_item_missing` and doc_status `success_with_warning`. An HONEST miss -- low confidence, warning fired, absence admitted -- but a miss: the heading is present and machine-readable, it simply names four codes where every heading path in src/sec10k/segment.py matches exactly one. WHY THIS CASE ASSERTS ITEM 10 ONLY, AND NOT ALL FOUR (corrected in repair round 2, PR #11 finding R8): a fix that attaches the one span to all four items is NOT BUILDABLE under the current contract. INV-S1 requires span-carrying ranges to be non-overlapping AND in document order; ADR-011 gives `incorporated_by_reference` real offsets, so only `missing`/`omitted` can be span-free. Four items sharing one span therefore fail this case's own `no_overlap_ordered` check. Nor can the block be partitioned: its ten caption bullets address items in the order 10, 10, 11, 10, 11, 12, 10, 11, 13, 10 -- interleaved -- so no document-ordered disjoint partition into 10 < 11 < 12 < 13 exists. The same wall stops any LLM fallback whose safety property is one contiguous verbatim slice. WHAT IS REACHABLE WITHOUT AMENDING ANYTHING: attach the block to item 10, the first code the heading names. One span, no overlap, contract-valid, and `segment.classify('10', body, True)` returns `extracted` on it -- correct under ADR-004, because the body is not pointer-only: after the proxy-IBR lead-in and its ten bullets it carries ~1,139 chars of substantive standalone prose (the Corporate Governance Principles / Code of Conduct paragraph, Reg S-K Item 406 code-of-ethics content, which explicitly says the linked website material 'is not incorporated by reference into this report'). Shape 3, `extracted`; ADR-007's remainder rule implements it as IBR only when the non-pointer remainder is <= IBR_REMAINDER_MAX (300), and 1,139 > 300. VERIFY: `python3 -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'.');from src.sec10k import normalize,segment;t=normalize.select_and_normalize(open('evals/fixtures/axp-2008/filing.htm','rb').read().decode('utf-8','replace'))[0];b=t[t.find('ITEMS'):t.find('ITEM 14')].split(chr(10)*2,1)[1];print(segment.classify('10',b,True))"` -> `extracted`. ITEMS 11, 12 AND 13 ARE DELIBERATELY NOT ASSERTED. They stay `missing`, and that is the honest report while the contract stands: the filing gives them no separable content, and giving them a status that carries offsets would either duplicate item 10's span (INV-S1) or invent a partition the document does not contain. Closing THAT half needs an INV-S1/contract amendment -- a shared or joint span kind -- which is a bigger decision than either the fan-out or the fallback question and belongs to its own ADR. Same family as msft-2013-website-block, which needs a discontiguous span kind. TWO EARLIER DRAFTS OF THIS CASE WERE WRONG, both caught by review and both recorded rather than quietly replaced: round 0 asserted `incorporated_by_reference` x4 (contradicted by `classify`; R1), round 1 asserted `extracted` x4 (contradicted by INV-S1; R8). WHY IT IS NOT FIXED: combined-heading fan-out is a new capability, forbidden by the T8 freeze without its own ADR -- the same reasoning that leaves ba-2003 and cvx-2015 unfixed. WHY IT MATTERS BEYOND ITSELF: this is the only item-recall gap in either eval set occurring in a real EDGAR filing with content present to find. The other 11 `missing` items across both sets are either genuinely absent from their documents (xom-2021 item 6; malformed-html item 1A) or sit in synthetic fixtures whose own committed expectations assert `missing` is the CORRECT answer (heading-unnumbered item 8; items-stripped-escalation items 5/6/7/7A/8/9/9A/9B). Item 10 here is therefore the ENTIRE contract-reachable fallback-addressable surface ADR-020 weighs: 1 of 768 distinct items. ADR-020 rules the LLM fallback out because a heading-shape change reaches that one item identically, deterministically, at $0, and because the other three are blocked by an invariant no extraction method can buy past.

provenance: T12 (2026-08-19), ADR-020. Scope corrected twice under review and both corrections are recorded here rather than silently applied: round 1 (PR #11 R1) replaced an `incorporated_by_reference` x4 assertion that src.sec10k.segment.classify contradicts; round 2 (PR #11 R8) replaced an `extracted` x4 assertion that INV-S1 contradicts, narrowing the case to the one item a contract-valid fix can reach. FOUND: by reading the committed held-out report evals/report/20260817-224952-fast.json (axp-2008-heldout: items 10, 11, 12, 13 all status=missing, confidence=0.40) against the document itself. The combined heading was verified in the RAW BYTES, not via the normalizer: re.finditer(r'ITEMS\b', raw) over the fixture returns exactly ONE hit, at offset 1225493. The singular strings 'Item 10'..'Item 13' occur zero times, which is what the original held-out provenance checked; its conclusion -- 'addressed Part III without writing the item headings at all' -- overreached from a singular-form scan. This filing writes Part III item codes WITHOUT the word 'Item' in both places it names them: the combined body heading, and its table of contents, which lists them as bare '10.' / '11.' / '12.' / '13.' entries. That is why trace layer 'candidates' reports toc_manifest: [] on a filing that has a complete contents page -- the TOC entries generate no heading candidates at all. THE ASSERTED STATUS IS NOT A JUDGEMENT CALL: `extracted` is what segment.classify returns on this body today (see the triage note's one-line repro), and item 10 alone is the only assignment that satisfies INV-S1 without a contract amendment, so the checks encode exactly what a contract-valid fan-out would produce and the case's green-contract is reachable. The min_chars floor pins that the real ~2,987-char block is attached rather than the heading line alone. The three hygiene checks are bookkeeping, as in cvx-2015-internal-pointer.json. Fixture moved to evals/fixtures/axp-2008/ when the held-out case was burned (ADR-020 section g). If these ever go green the runner says 'NOW GREEN -- promote it'.
